preconditions: The four packet functions execute during content/mesh loading: 0x005518A0 invokes 0x005508A0, 0x0055B200 invokes 0x0053CE10, and five sites invoke 0x00543FA0 (0x004A2A90, 0x004D0110, 0x004DFCE0, 0x00546010, 0x00559200).
0x005508A0 requires a2 to be a non-null NUL-terminated file name and the output struct this to be caller-owned and writable.
0x00550AD0 requires a2 to be an open file handle positioned at the data start (file path) or a3 to be a valid parent context (embedded sub-block path).

0x00543FA0 requires this[84] and the four bucket pointers to be either null or prior allocations owned by the same object; the scene-graph list at this[64] and audio list at this[66] must be valid linked structures.
0x0053CE10 requires a1 to point at a writable slot holding the loaded-object pointer when sub_53CBC0 succeeds.
postconditions: 0x005508A0 returns 0 with the output struct zeroed then populated by the load; returns -1 and reports a specific error string through sub_53C590 on any failure without populating the struct.

0x00550AD0 returns 0 with flags/scale/dimension/name and material (flags bit 2) or texture/animation (flags bit 1) descriptor arrays populated in this; returns -1 on a short read after freeing both temporary buffers.
0x00543FA0 returns 0 after freeing and reallocating the draw-element array and the four bucket arrays with consistent counts; returns -1 when a scene-graph or audio-list walk fails.
0x0053CE10 returns the sub_53CBC0 result unchanged; on success (0) with non-null a1, sets bit 3 at obj+0x114.
side_effects: 0x00543FA0 allocates via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (0x00587C03) and frees via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF), rebuilding this[84] and the four bucket arrays and reinitializing per-element objects.
0x00543FA0 mutates the global addend at 0x008B8EEC via InterlockedDecrement and reads global 0x0059E234 during the audio-list walk; reads global 0x008B78A0 in the vertex-format construction.
0x005508A0 opens and closes file handles via the sub_587DB0/sub_587D02 wrappers and walks the registered path-directory table (dword_8B8E30 / byte_8B5A3C) and the MAS animation list (dword_8B8F14).
0x00550AD0 writes the shared read buffers dword_8B8F30 / dword_8B8F34 and read-cursor dword_8B8F3C, then frees the buffers before returning.
0x0053CE10 writes the flags dword at *a1 + 0x114, OR-ing bit value 8.

disputes.description: The packet leaves owner as UnknownObject for all four functions. Architecture excerpts assign 0x00550AD0 to MeshDataFile and 0x005508A0 to MeshResourceLoader, but no caller, constructor, or direct field use in this packet proves a shared owning class; equal this-offset patterns are treated as facts, not ownership.

A single signature cannot represent all four functions: 0x0053CE10 is __stdcall(_DWORD *, CHAR *), 0x00543FA0 is __thiscall(), 0x005508A0 is __thiscall(_BYTE *, const char *), 0x00550AD0 is __thiscall(float *, int, int). The signature documents the caller-facing mesh-load entry 0x005508A0 only.

0x0053CE10 is proposed as ErrorHandlerSet but its body is a wrapper around the MAS loader sub_53CBC0 that sets one flag bit at obj+0x114 on success; the name overstates the role and is not evidenced by the raw C.

The exact semantics of ArithmeticComparison_a5c0 (0x0054A5C0) buffer-cursor reads, the sub-block layout at context+296 with the byte index at +292<<8, and the header bit 0x10 are not established by this packet.
The shared read buffers dword_8B8F30 / dword_8B8F34 and read cursor dword_8B8F3C act as a global mesh-read state; whether that state is safe under concurrency is not evidenced here.

The sentinel semantics of dword_8B6AC0 (MAS counter comparison), the 0x100000 / 0x400000 pointer sentinels in the 0x00543FA0 material walk, and the jump table at 0x00544720 are DERIVED or literal-only observations, not proven semantics.
Threading context (which thread runs load vs. render paths) is not established; InterlockedDecrement use in 0x00543FA0 hints at concurrency but does not prove a thread requirement.
The 24-byte draw-element array (this[84]) and the per-slot descriptor fields (256 flag, 16-byte data allocation) built by 0x00543FA0 have roles that are not provable from this packet alone.
tests_required: Load a known mesh path through 0x005508A0 and verify a 0 return, a populated output struct, and the exact per-failure error strings (Illegal mesh file name / Error loading animation file / Error loading MAS animation file / Could not locate mesh file).
Feed 0x00550AD0 a short file and an embedded sub-block and verify a -1 return on short read with both temporary buffers freed and dword_8B8F30 / dword_8B8F34 restored.
Call 0x00543FA0 twice and verify the draw-element and four bucket arrays are rebuilt with matching counts and no leak (buffer pointer identity changes).
Verify 0x0053CE10 sets bit 3 at obj+0x114 only when sub_53CBC0 returns 0 and a1 is non-null.
